title: A Aftermath for the Silence
author: Mara Coldharbour
blurb: Dominic Villalobos, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
